data.name: GuideGeneric
data.value:
This MCP needs an API key.
1. Click “Open site” for the dashboard that issues the key. 2. Sign in and create an API key / token / integration. 3. Copy the key. 4. Click “Token” on this MCP in XNGPad and paste it. 5. I will write it into environment in opencode.json. 6. Restart OpenCode.
The key is a secret. Do not commit the config.

data.name: GuideGithub
data.value:
You need a GitHub Personal Access Token.
1. Open github.com and sign in. 2. Click your avatar (top right) → Settings. 3. Bottom left: Developer settings. 4. Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic). 5. Generate new token (classic). 6. Any name, pick an expiry. 7. Enable repo (for private repos). public_repo is enough for public ones. 8. Generate token. Copy it now — GitHub will not show it again. 9. In opencode.json under mcp.github.environment set: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN = that token
Do not commit the token or paste it in public chats.

data.name: GuideGitlab
data.value:
You need a GitLab Personal Access Token.
1. Open gitlab.com (or your GitLab) and sign in. 2. Avatar → Preferences. 3. Left: Access Tokens. 4. Add new token. 5. Any name. Scopes: read_api and read_repository (add write_repository to write). 6. Create personal access token. Copy it now. 7. In opencode.json under mcp.gitlab.environment: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN = token If not gitlab.com, also GITLAB_API_URL = https://your-gitlab/api/v4
Keep the token secret.

data.name: GuideSlack
data.value:
You need a Slack Bot Token.
1. Open https://api.slack.com/apps 2. Create New App → From scratch. 3. App name and workspace. 4. Left: OAuth & Permissions. 5. Bot Token Scopes: channels:history, channels:read, chat:write (add more if needed). 6. Install to Workspace. Approve. 7. Copy Bot User OAuth Token — it starts with xoxb- 8. In opencode.json under mcp.slack.environment: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN = xoxb-...
This token can read the workspace. Treat it like a password.

data.name: GuideBrave
data.value:
You need a Brave Search API key.
1. Open https://brave.com/search/api/ 2. Get started / Subscribe and register. 3. In the API dashboard create an API key. 4. Copy the key. 5. In opencode.json under mcp.brave-search.environment: BRAVE_API_KEY = key
The free quota is small. This MCP will not work without a key.

data.name: GuideMaps
data.value:
You need a Google Maps API key.
1. Open https://console.cloud.google.com/ 2. Create a project (or pick one). 3. APIs & Services → Library. Enable Maps JavaScript API and Places API (Geocoding too if you need it). 4. APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → API key. 5. Restrict the key to Maps APIs. 6. In opencode.json under mcp.google-maps.environment: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = key
The key is tied to Google Cloud billing. Set quotas.

data.name: GuideGdrive
data.value:
You need Google Drive OAuth access.
1. https://console.cloud.google.com/ — a project. 2. APIs & Services → Library → enable Google Drive API. 3. APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID. 4. Type: Desktop app. Download the client JSON. 5. OAuth consent screen: External, add your Gmail as a test user. 6. The gdrive MCP README says where to put credentials.json (often GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = path to the json).
The first run opens a Google browser login — use the account whose Drive you need.

data.name: GuideSentry
data.value:
You need a Sentry Auth Token.
1. Sign in at https://sentry.io 2. Avatar → User settings → Auth Tokens or Organization settings → Auth Tokens. 3. Create New Token. 4. Scopes: project:read, event:read (more if you write). 5. Copy the token. 6. In opencode.json under mcp.sentry.environment: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN = token You may also need SENTRY_ORG = the slug from sentry.io/organizations/THIS-SLUG/
Do not publish the token.

data.name: GuidePostgres
data.value:
You need a PostgreSQL connection string, not a website token.
Format: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DATABASE
Examples: • local: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/app • hosted: panel (Railway, Supabase, Neon) → Connection string / URI.
Put it in the postgres MCP command args in opencode.json, or in environment, as that MCP’s README says.
The password in the URI is a secret. Do not commit it.

data.name: GuideRedis
data.value:
You need a Redis URL, not a GitHub token.
Usually: redis://127.0.0.1:6379 or redis://:PASSWORD@HOST:6379
Where: • local Redis → 127.0.0.1 port 6379 • cloud (Redis Cloud, Upstash) → Connect / URL tab
Put the URL in the redis MCP command or environment in opencode.json, as the GitHub README says.
The password in the URL is a secret.

data.name: GuideTelegram
data.value:
Telegram MCP (steps)
1. Open the site with the button below: my.telegram.org/apps 2. Sign in with your phone (the code arrives in Telegram). 3. Create an app if you do not have one. Any name. 4. Copy api_id (number) and api_hash (long string). 5. In XNGPad click Add on Telegram and paste both values. 6. I write npx mcp-telegram with no extra arguments. The start argument breaks OpenCode — it must not be there. 7. Restart OpenCode and ask the agent to call login. Telegram sign-in happens in the browser, not in this form. 8. In OpenCode chat: “show unread Telegram chats”.
This uses your user account, not a bot. Do not commit opencode.json.

data.name: GuideKompas
data.value:
KOMPAS-3D MCP (steps)
KOMPAS-3D must already be installed on this PC.
1. Click Add. I download kompas-mcp.exe, request config.json from kompasmcp.ru, and save it to %USERPROFILE%\.kompasmcp\config.json. 2. Start KOMPAS-3D (one instance). 3. Restart OpenCode. 4. In chat: “create a 20×20×10 mm part” or “draw a 100×50 rectangle”.
If the site invite changed, click Token and paste the new code or the JSON. If tools do not respond, KOMPAS must be open.

data.name: GuideOffice
data.value:
Microsoft Office MCP (steps)
Word / Excel / PowerPoint must be installed, plus Python 3.11+.
1. Click Add on Excel, Word, or PowerPoint. 2. If Python is missing I try to install it with winget. 3. Then pip install mcp-office and write opencode.json. 4. Files are taken from Desktop\projects if that folder exists, otherwise your profile. 5. Restart OpenCode. 6. In chat: “open this workbook and sum column B” or “build a docx from this text”.
Do not pip install excelmcp from PyPI — the package is mcp-office.
